assertions.judge: Ran the generated skill once end to end: start, drive one feature, stop
Every citation in the skill matches the file it cites
Start and stop touch only the process the skill started
Every file:line citation in the skill carries the quoted text of the line it cites
No instruction in the skill kills a process found by its port, and its fix for a port in use leaves the process holding the port alone
Every shell script the skill wrote reports eol: lf from git check-attr
